# yellowdog_compute_source_template (Resource)

Manages a compute source template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A compute source template describes one place instances can be provisioned:
# a cloud provider, account, region, network and instance type. Compute
# requirement templates draw on them. Set exactly one of the *_compute_source
# attributes of source.
#
# credential names a keyring credential as "<keyring name>/<credential name>".

# AWS instances, launched individually.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "aws_instances" {
  namespace   = "example-namespace"
  description = "On-demand t3a instances in eu-west-2"

  source = {
    aws_instances_compute_source = {
      name              = "aws-eu-west-2"
      credential        = "example-keyring/aws"
      region            = "eu-west-2"
      image_id          = "ami-09dbc7ce74870d573"
      instance_type     = "t3a.micro"
      security_group_id = "sg-0123456789abcdef0"
      subnet_id         = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
      assign_public_ip  = true
      limit             = 10

      instance_tags = {
        team = "research"
      }
    }
  }

  # User attributes, for dynamic compute requirement templates to constrain
  # and rank sources by. Each must already be defined in the account.
  attributes = [
    {
      string_attribute_value = {
        attribute = "user.tier"
        value     = "production"
      }
    },
    {
      numeric_attribute_value = {
        attribute = "user.priority"
        value     = 10
      }
    },
  ]
}

# An AWS EC2 Fleet, which can mix instance types and spot and on-demand
# capacity.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "aws_fleet" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    aws_fleet_compute_source = {
      name              = "aws-fleet-eu-west-2"
      credential        = "example-keyring/aws"
      region            = "eu-west-2"
      image_id          = "ami-09dbc7ce74870d573"
      instance_type     = "t3a.micro"
      security_group_id = "sg-0123456789abcdef0"
      subnet_id         = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
      purchase_option   = "SPOT_THEN_ON_DEMAND"
      limit             = 50

      instance_overrides = [
        { instance_type = "t3a.small" },
        { instance_type = "t3.small" },
      ]

      spot_options = {
        allocation_strategy = "PRICE_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED"
      }
    }
  }
}

# Azure virtual machines, launched individually.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "azure_instances" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    azure_instances_compute_source = {
      name                        = "azure-uksouth"
      credential                  = "example-keyring/azure"
      admin_user_credential       = "example-keyring/azure-admin"
      region                      = "uksouth"
      image_id                    = "market:Canonical:0001-com-ubuntu-server-jammy:22_04-lts:latest"
      vm_size                     = "Standard_B1s"
      network_resource_group_name = "example-network-rg"
      network_name                = "example-vnet"
      subnet_name                 = "default"
      limit                       = 10
    }
  }
}

# An Azure virtual machine scale set.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "azure_scale_set" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    azure_scale_set_compute_source = {
      name                        = "azure-scale-set-uksouth"
      credential                  = "example-keyring/azure"
      admin_user_credential       = "example-keyring/azure-admin"
      region                      = "uksouth"
      image_id                    = "market:Canonical:0001-com-ubuntu-server-jammy:22_04-lts:latest"
      vm_size                     = "Standard_B1s"
      network_resource_group_name = "example-network-rg"
      network_name                = "example-vnet"
      subnet_name                 = "default"
      use_spot                    = true
      limit                       = 50
    }
  }
}

# Google Compute Engine instances, launched individually.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "gce_instances" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    gce_instances_compute_source = {
      name         = "gce-europe-west2"
      credential   = "example-keyring/gcp"
      project      = "example-project"
      region       = "europe-west2"
      zone         = "europe-west2-a"
      image        = "projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/ubuntu-2204-jammy-v20240904"
      machine_type = "e2-micro"
      network      = "default"
      subnetwork   = "default"
      limit        = 10
    }
  }
}

# A Google Compute Engine managed instance group.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "gce_instance_group" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    gce_instance_group_compute_source = {
      name                      = "gce-group-europe-west2"
      credential                = "example-keyring/gcp"
      project                   = "example-project"
      region                    = "europe-west2"
      image                     = "projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/ubuntu-2204-jammy-v20240904"
      machine_type              = "e2-micro"
      target_distribution_shape = "BALANCED"
      spot                      = true
      limit                     = 50
    }
  }
}

# Oracle Cloud Infrastructure instances, launched individually.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "oci_instances" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    oci_instances_compute_source = {
      name           = "oci-uk-london-1"
      credential     = "example-keyring/oci"
      region         = "uk-london-1"
      compartment_id = "ocid1.compartment.oc1..aaaaaaaaexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexample"
      subnet_id      = "ocid1.subnet.oc1.uk-london-1.aaaaaaaaexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexample"
      image_id       = "ocid1.image.oc1.uk-london-1.aaaaaaaaxwu543plnc7ulnexmpxz6eifxk7eqxnnbwxtnzsxpckw7ogfesrq"
      shape          = "VM.Standard.E5.Flex"
      # Flex shapes need their OCPU count and memory (GB).
      flex_ocpus = 1
      flex_ram   = 8
      limit      = 10
    }
  }
}

# An Oracle Cloud Infrastructure instance pool.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "oci_instance_pool" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    oci_instance_pool_compute_source = {
      name           = "oci-pool-uk-london-1"
      credential     = "example-keyring/oci"
      region         = "uk-london-1"
      compartment_id = "ocid1.compartment.oc1..aaaaaaaaexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexample"
      subnet_id      = "ocid1.subnet.oc1.uk-london-1.aaaaaaaaexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexampleexample"
      image_id       = "ocid1.image.oc1.uk-london-1.aaaaaaaaxwu543plnc7ulnexmpxz6eifxk7eqxnnbwxtnzsxpckw7ogfesrq"
      shape          = "VM.Standard.E5.Flex"
      flex_ocpus     = 1
      flex_ram       = 8
      limit          = 50
    }
  }
}

# A simulated source, which provisions no real instances: useful for trying
# out templates and workflows without a cloud account or cost.
resource "yellowdog_compute_source_template" "simulator" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"

  source = {
    simulator_compute_source = {
      name                          = "simulator"
      region                        = "sim-region-1"
      instance_type                 = "sim-small"
      image_id                      = "sim-image-1"
      implicit_capacity             = 100
      instance_startup_time_seconds = 30
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.aws_fleet_compute_source`

Required:

- `credential` (String)
- `image_id` (String) The region-specific Amazon Machine Image (AMI) ID for the image to use for the provisioned instances. In a compute source template, this may instead be the ID of a `yellowdog_machine_image`, `yellowdog_machine_image_group` or `yellowdog_machine_image_family`, resolved to a matching AMI ID when a compute requirement is provisioned from the template, or "*" for the image to be supplied by the compute requirement template or when provisioning from it. A value in a compute source template is not checked until a compute requirement is provisioned from it.
- `instance_type` (String) The EC2 instance type for the provisioned instances.
- `name` (String)
- `purchase_option` (String) Determines which instance purchase options (On-Demand and/or Spot) are available to AWS EC2 Fleet.
- `region` (String) The AWS region where instances will be provisioned.
- `security_group_id` (String) The ID of the AWS Security Group for the provisioned instances.

Optional:

- `assign_public_ip` (Boolean) Indicates if provisioned instances should be assigned public IP addresses.

  Defaults to `false`.
- `availability_zone` (String) The AWS availability zone within the region where instances will be provisioned.
- `boot_volume_size_gb` (Number)
- `capacity_reservation` (Attributes) Specifies the capacity reservation to target for provisioned instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source--capacity_reservation))
- `create_cluster_placement_group` (Boolean) Indicates if instances should be provisioned within a cluster placement group.
- `create_elastic_fabric_adapter` (Boolean) Indicates if instances should be provisioned with an Elastic Fabric Adapter network interface.
- `enable_detailed_monitoring` (Boolean) Indicates if provisioned instances should have detailed CloudWatch monitoring enabled.
- `enable_instance_metadata_tags` (Boolean) Indicates if provisioned instances should expose their tags via instance metadata.
- `existing_placement_group` (Attributes) Indicates an existing placement group within which instances should be provisioned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source--existing_placement_group))
- `iam_instance_profile_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM Instance Profile to use for the provisioned instances.
- `instance_metadata_http_put_response_hop_limit` (Number) The number of network hops that an instance metadata service (IMDS) response is allowed to travel from provisioned instances. If null, the AWS default of 1 is used, which only allows processes running on the instance's host network to reach IMDS. Raise this when task workloads run in containers and need IMDS access (for example, to obtain instance-profile credentials or instance metadata): each container network boundary the response must cross consumes one hop, so use 2 for a single bridged container and 3 or more for nested, container-in-container workloads.
- `instance_overrides` (Attributes List) Extra instance provision options that can override the main parameters set in this source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source--instance_overrides))
- `instance_tags` (Map of String)
- `key_name` (String) The name of the EC2 key pair to use when logging into any instances provisioned from this source.
- `limit` (Number) Defaults to `0`.
- `maintain_capacity` (Boolean) Indicates if AWS EC2 Fleet should maintain the instance count independently of YellowDog Compute, replacing the reprovision functionality.

  Defaults to `false`.
- `on_demand_options` (Attributes) Options related to provisioning On-Demand instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source--on_demand_options))
- `secondary_network_interfaces` (Attributes List) Secondary network interfaces to create on provisioned instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source--secondary_network_interfaces))
- `spot_options` (Attributes) Options related to provisioning Spot instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--aws_fleet_compute_source--spot_options))
- `subnet_id` (String) The ID of the subnet to use for the provisioned instances.
- `user_data` (String)

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)

- `single_instance_type` (Boolean) Indicates that AWS EC2 Fleet should use a single instance type to provision all Spot instances.

### Nested Schema for `source.gce_instances_compute_source`

Required:

- `credential` (String)
- `image` (String)
- `machine_type` (String)
- `name` (String)

- `region` (String)

Optional:

- `accelerator_count` (Number) Defaults to `0`.

  Defaults to `false`.
- `boot_volume_size_gb` (Number)
- `confidential` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `create_compact_placement_policy` (Boolean) Indicates if instances should be provisioned using a compact placement policy.
- `host_maintenance_behaviour` (String)
- `instance_tags` (Map of String)
- `limit` (Number) Defaults to `0`.
- `network` (String)
- `preemptible` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `reservation` (String) The reservation to provision instances from: its name, or projects/PROJECT/reservations/NAME for one shared from another project.
- `reservation_bound` (Boolean) Indicates if instances should be reservation-bound, as a capacity block or calendar-mode future reservation requires. Requires reservation. Reservation-bound instances are deleted when the reservation ends.

  Defaults to `false`.
- `service_account_email` (String) The email of the service account to attach to provisioned instances, granting them access to other Google Cloud resources.
- `specify_minimum` (Boolean) Indicates if YellowDog Compute should specify the minimum when requesting instances. NB: This can only be used with a limit set between 1..1000 If true, then no instances are provisioned unless all requested instances are available; otherwise, if false, YellowDog Compute will provision as many instances as possible up to the number requested from this compute source.

  Defaults to `false`.

- `ssh_keys` (String) A list of public SSH keys. If provided, instances will be accessible with the matching private keys through SSH.

- `user_data` (String)
- `zone` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--source--simulator_compute_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.simulator_compute_source`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `fail_on_provision` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `fail_on_request_all_instances` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `image_id` (String) Defaults to `"sim-image"`.
- `implicit_capacity` (Number) The implicit capacity of this source that is not directly discoverable by the compute service, independent of limit.
- `instance_shutdown_time_seconds` (Number) The simulated shutdown time for an instance.

  Defaults to `0`.
- `instance_shutdown_time_variance` (Number) A variance multiplier (from 0 to 1) applied randomly to the instance shutdown time.

  Defaults to `0`.
- `instance_startup_time_seconds` (Number) The simulated startup time for an instance.

  Defaults to `0`.
- `instance_startup_time_variance` (Number) A variance multiplier (from 0 to 1) applied randomly to the instance startup time.

  Defaults to `0`.

- `instance_type` (String) Defaults to `"sim-instance"`.
- `limit` (Number) Defaults to `0`.
- `region` (String) Defaults to `"sim-region"`.
- `report_supporting_resources_exist` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `unexpected_instance_termination_probability` (Number) The probability (from 0 to 1) that any instance will be unexpectedly terminated whenever it is refreshed.

  Defaults to `0`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the compute source template's YDID.
terraform import yellowdog_compute_source_template.aws_instances ydid:cst:000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
